# Carl & Cecilia Meredith

- [Carl](../character/carl.md) — Child of — [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md) — since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) settles into life at the manse, attending church in borrowed clothes and taking over housecleaning while refusing to return to school. She forms a bond with the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), fascinating them with ghost stories and feats while clashing occasionally with [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Faith](../character/faith.md).

> — v5 · CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes deeply absorbed in studying [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, resulting in complete distraction from his pastoral and domestic duties. Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) arrives at the manse and abruptly demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), which Mr. Meredith firmly refuses. Outraged, Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) berates him for neglecting his children, leaving him shaken and reflecting on how to properly care for his family.
